comments.body: You will need the Persian language or Indian Ocean translation notes to finish this quest.

comments.body: The relevant translation note is not sold in Istanbul, btw.

comments.body: this quest was nice till i had to use persian >.

comments.author: DeK
comments.body: If you find yourself without Persian and have the Suez permit you can take the canal and buy Indian Ocean translation notes in Aden. The other option is to learn the language on the east coast of Africa (Zanzibar or Mozambique).

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: Having an aide with Persian works pretty nice too. It can even be a fleetmate's aide!
